title: Akbari–Dalirrooyfard–Ehsani–Ozeki–Sherkati list-avoiding orientation conjecture
statement:
Let $G$ be a graph and let $F:V(G)\to 2^{\mathbb{N}}$. An orientation $D$ of $G$ is **$F$-avoiding** if $\deg_D^+(v)\notin F(v)$ for every $v\in V(G)$. **The list-avoiding orientation conjecture.** If

$$
|F(v)|\leq \frac{1}{2}(\deg_G(v)-1)
$$

for each $v\in V(G)$, then $G$ has an $F$-avoiding orientation. This strengthens the earlier bound with $\frac14$ and is sharp if true; related results are known for spanning subgraphs, but the orientation statement remains open.
source_name: Peter Bradshaw, Yaobin Chen, Hao Ma, Bojan Mohar and Hehui Wu, “List-avoiding orientations”, arXiv:2209.09107 (2024).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.09107

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of September 2022).
